name: a link to a big folder lists exactly the files it was made with, each one readable; files added later from another device while the owner is offline are not in it, and nothing fails to decrypt
description: SYNCCOM-024 (Sync.com): link recipients saw 'Failed Decryption' until the owner's client finished link encryption; links to big folders left files out. Rules M1/S14/I1 (sync-chaos share-links-and-revocation): share keys go with the upload's commit. A share link is a snapshot (azul-storage sharing.rs): files added to the folder after the link are not in it - never listed as an entry that fails to decrypt. A live folder link needs folder keys in the drive index (not built).
